title: Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon-

guide_target.label: Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon- Download Edition (2021, Japanese)

routes.title: 1. アルクェイド / Arcueid + Dead Ends 01–11
routes.notes: NEW GAME, save before the first choice, then KANNAGI's Arcueid path. Independent optional variants from XNEO are retained as evidence, not concatenated into a single path. Asobigokoro local saves 1–10 map to global saves 2–11.

routes.title: 2. シエル Normal / 夜の虹 + Dead Ends 12–19
routes.notes: Load global Save 1 or start NEW GAME after Arcueid clear. Use the Ciel-specific early choices. Follow KANNAGI's Day 4 refusal/leave/return/glasses choices and Day 8 Arcueid preference, preparing the documented path for Extra, not every high-affection scene. Dead End 15 is fully expanded through Day 11 before loading global Save 14 on Day 9. Dead End 14 now uses KANNAGI's EARLIER conversation-delay entrance immediately after Save 15, then reloads and performs the good conversation once. Asobigokoro local saves 3–11 map to global saves 12–20; its local 1–2 duplicate already-collected common dead ends.

routes.title: 3. シエル Extra / 白日の碧 + Dead Ends 20–21
routes.notes: Load global Save 20 only AFTER clearing Normal. The save retains the affection state from the exact preceding playthrough. Asobigokoro local saves 12–13 map to global saves 21–22. Final Ciel lesson is described in the terminal English hint, not added as an invented OCR choice.

source_policy.set_A: KANNAGI common, heroine, and bad-end pages.
source_policy.set_B: XNEO for choices by default; Asobigokoro for save annotations, ending labels, and the individually documented supplemental choices.
source_policy.field_semantics: jpGuide1/jpGuide2 preserve the source wording, including differing optional choices. They are evidence, not two instructions to execute. simpleJp is the selected path. Missing-source fields use the upstream canonical placeholders.
supplemental_B_choices: Ciel Day 13 金とかどうでもいい。スルーできない。
Ciel Day 13 琥珀を追い返す。 (also in XNEO)
Dead End 15 silent response 『……(いや、下手な言葉は逆効果だ)』
source_policy.literal_reconciliation: Original A/B quotations are preserved. Ciel Normal step 13 was independently reconciled with the official 2021 menu image. Independent r3 reproduction at https://github.com/kanjieater/VN-Guide/pull/98#issuecomment-6461638207 verified the other 13 payloads and 14 SELR references recorded in menu-text-evidence.json. On 2026-10-28 owner kanjieater explicitly waived exact storefront/download packaging and patch-build provenance for only those 13 literals, conditional on remake attribution: https://github.com/kanjieater/VN-Guide/pull/98#issuecomment-6476454232. prompt_supplement.md enumerates the exact steps and evidence. Pinned Knife identifies the Switch remake and its Japanese archive class; the referenced Arcueid/Ciel scenes are remake-specific, not original-Tsukihime assets. The reproduced payloads resolve transcription differences under that narrow provenance waiver, not fabricated A/B agreement. No other facts, route states or source coverage are waived; independent review of the revised source basis remains required.
source_policy.english: Author-written English explanations cross-checked against NookGaming. Not an English-OCR guide.

disagreements: KANNAGI and XNEO choose different optional Day 1/2 scenes on Arcueid. The guide follows one continuous KANNAGI path, rather than splicing choice variants.
Japanese guides give multiple optional number guesses and Day 11 Arcueid responses. This guide selects one documented option, not every scene.

Japanese sources differ on パンを買って/買ってきて, もう少し/もうすこし, 俺が/俺の, glasses-choice prefixes, quotation marks, and ellipsis/dash lengths. Source quotations remain verbatim. The official menu image reconciles 俺の; the independently reproduced remake asset payloads resolve the other 13 literal discrepancies under the owner's 2026-10-28 fact-scoped provenance waiver, not by choosing a walkthrough spelling by preference.
NookGaming uses different optional Ciel Day 2/6/12 scenes and the other valid final-warning response on Extra. This guide follows the Japanese path.
KANNAGI omits 琥珀を追い返す。; XNEO and Asobigokoro both document it, so it is included.

Dead End 15: KANNAGI supplies a complete Day 9–11 sequence. Asobigokoro documents an extended alternative, including 因果応報, はっきりと言い返す, greeting everyone, the curry response, and a later Noel question. The guide keeps KANNAGI's continuous chain and Asobigokoro's documented checkpoint, without combining alternative state/choice chains. Both sets document the silent response with differing typography; both quotations are now present.

Dead End 14: KANNAGI documents two entrances. This guide now uses the earlier 問題はない。話は放課後にすればいいし。 entrance at Asobigokoro's source-backed conversation checkpoint. After the terminal it loads Save 15 and performs the good conversation once; removing the marked detour also leaves the conversation once.
KANNAGI's bad-end HTML accidentally duplicates id=bad-end-15 for Dead Ends 14 and 15. Labels/content, not those anchors, identify the branches.

Historical follow-up: XNEO, Game × First Impression, and Ponkotu Gamer independently print 俺の起こした現実だ on Day 3; simpleJp uses の rather than KANNAGI's が. Walkthrough agreement alone was not accepted as menu proof. Original Set A/B quotations remain unchanged.

Ciel Normal zero-based step 13: actual official menu pixels at https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E-MB_x8VgAIvqJy.jpg?name=orig display ……いや、俺の起こした現実だ。 The official post https://twitter.com/TM_TSUKIHIME/status/1432992458451812354 is dated 2021-09-01T09:03:20Z. Independent accuracy re-review https://github.com/kanjieater/VN-Guide/pull/98#issuecomment-6457378314 resolved this particular string within the publisher's original PS4/Switch product scope. The image still does not identify capture hardware, build or download SKU; it is not a hardware-identified r82483 capture or 2024-equivalence proof. Existing simpleJp and both primary quotations are retained.

The earlier public-image searches did not resolve the other 13 literals. The caller then authorized inspecting the locally installed game while prohibiting changes to existing saves. A headless read-only decoder parsed script_text.mrg language slot 0 and allscr.mrg from the installed original Japanese assets, without launching the game. The small menu-text-evidence.json ledger records all 13 exact strings, archive hashes, text IDs, scene names and SELR byte offsets; verify-choice-text.rs reproduces the cross-reference check using the pinned public Knife parsers. No full script, ROM, screenshot of private save data or save file is published.

Direct payload reconciliation supplied five simpleJp corrections: Arcueid step 54 uses すこし (text ID 42639); Ciel Normal step 26 has three U+2015 leading bars and a trailing ellipsis (42695); steps 64 and 65 use U+3000 after ？ (42734/42735); step 81 uses は rather than を (42751). Independent r3 reproduced these and the eight already-matching strings, including six U+2026 characters before いや、それは (42755). Original jpGuide1/jpGuide2 spellings are deliberately unchanged. The owner accepted these 13 literals subject to remake attribution, without demanding exact packaging/patch identity. Fresh accuracy review must verify this revised route/research basis; this author record is not a PASS.

Extraction provenance: the caller's installed data has the Japanese remake build's unprefixed archives and no w_allpac.nam, following Knife's build selector. Independent r3 checked decoder source against public commit 794bcc5e14be6bd4bf44716f160a280f4306ab1d, freshly compiled the verifier and separately reproduced each KDU line. That source explicitly identifies the Switch remake, and the extracted scene references are remake-specific. This satisfies the attribution condition of the owner's 13-literal-only waiver. The bundle still does not establish a storefront receipt/control.nacp or installed patch version; that requirement is waived for these exact literals, not proven. No hardware capture, packaging-specific identity or 2021/2024 binary equivalence is asserted.

Follow-up: Ponkotu Gamer distinguishes Extra entry from additional late high-affection flowchart scenes. Its warning that refusing cooperation lowers affection means the old hint that this refusal preserves affection was misleading and has been corrected. The documented KANNAGI/XNEO/NookGaming route still uses that refusal; no claim is made that it fills every high-affection variant.
Follow-up: Ponkotu Gamer independently confirms the Day 9 painful/ineffective medicine forces Dead End 15 on Day 11; the expanded detour is retained.
